segments.text: Kadatru mudra mantri viri asadane for attaining these two powers, powers of creative energy
and powers of establishing, establishment in that creative energy, for attainment of
these two powers, Guru-rubhaya.
The one who extracts money from his disciples, the one who makes his disciples work in his
garden, sweep all the premises, is not Guru.
That person who puts before you the reality of God consciousness, is Guru, is Master.
So after Vyavtipradarshagatthena upaya, he is means here because Vyavtipradarshagena,
because Master only can make one realize the fullness of these two awarenesses, these two
awarenesses of Mudra and Mantra.
Tadukhamri maal ne Vijaya, it is coated in maal ne Vijatantra, Sagarur, Madsama, Prokto,
Mantri viri, Brakashaka.
That Master who makes you attain the creative energy of Lord Shiva and makes you establish
in that state.
That Master is as good as me.
That Master is one with Lord Shiva, in other words, spandhya tu mmaadiprasi dattat narsangrheetam.
In spanda, it is not narrated.
This point is not narrated regarding Master, but in itapari antikokthya, in the last shloka
of spanda, this also is narrated in this shloka.
Aga, the samshayam bodhi samudtaranatharini, vande vichitrarth padam, chitram, tam, gurubharyatim.
I bow to that Supreme and wonderful world of Master, tam, chitram, gurubharyatim, vande.
I bow to that Supreme and wonderful world of Master, and that gives rise of various ways
of Supreme thought.
Aga, the samshayam bodhi samudtaranatharini, and karis, shisya, is disciple and makes him
cross the ocean of all doubts.
Guru Rua, parmeshary, Anagraha, kashakti.
In other words, some Masters take this that Master is not Master, worldly being.
There is, in real sense, this Supreme energy of Lord Shiva is Master, because it is said
in Mahalini vijya, shakti, chakram, tade voktam, gurubhaktram, tadu, chade, that is the
wheel of all energies, and that is the mouth of Master, where everything is obtained.
The great energy of great Lord is said to be the mouth of Master, hence that energy being
the cause of understanding is upaya.
Now this Shloka is, samudar subject, we will do it next, on next Saturday, right?
